audit.why: TRICKY 7/10 fits: Syndra bullies the ranged early phase (53.7% WR, 3253 games), Pantheon flips it at 6 with the Comet Spear execute and Grand Starfall roams, and Syndra out-scales into teamfights. Content layer already tells this story.
Spikes recorded and correct: Syndra levels 1-5, Pantheon at 6 and first item (Eclipse + Empowered W), Syndra late through teamfight AoE. spikes[] has all 4 entries.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three interactions applied but were unstated on the full layer: Aegis Assault's frontal invulnerability eats a timed R; Aegis is a channel that Syndra's E cancels outright; Pantheon's combo opens with a Shield Vault auto-reset wind-up (the real back-off cue).
audit.why: All three come from the brief's missingInteractions plus enemy kit flags (untargetable, channel, autoReset).
audit.corrected: Written into dontsFull[2].d, breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d respectively.

audit.why: Kit: Shield Vault 13s rank 1 / 9s max, Aegis Assault 22-18s, Grand Starfall 180/165/150s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer level chart rows 0-3 said Pantheon while content win[0-3], the packet chart and the whys all say Syndra; rows 4-6 said the neutral 'Skill' while win[4-6] say Pantheon. Whys were the generic Syndra-bully template contradicting the Pantheon-side rows.
audit.why: Packet levelChart and content layer agree: Syndra x4 then Pantheon x3. The full layer was the outlier both directions.
audit.corrected: All 7 sides aligned to the packet/content verdicts with grounded why rewrites in the same group.

edits.before: - Pantheon Shield Vault (Stun): matchup-defining — Point-and-click stun — respect the all-in any time it is up. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E Scatter the Weak has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Pantheon Shield Vault (Stun): 13s rank 1, 9s max — point-and-click; respect the all-in any time it is up. - Aegis Assault: 22s and a channel — your E cancels it, and an R fired after it is spent cannot be blocked. - Grand Starfall: 180s — every roam is bought.

edits.before: Point-and-click stun — respect the all-in any time it is up. Bait it, count it, then go.
edits.after: His combo opens with a W auto-reset — the wind-up, not the cast, is your cue to slow and back.

edits.before: Q the last-hit, W-slow the dodge attempt, QE the slowed line, Q again — a full bar of damage that started as routine poke.
edits.after: Shield Vault is a 13s dash-stun your E reads mid-flight — the knockback interrupts it and turns his engage into a stun on him.

edits.before: Spending E on chip-spacing and then watching the dash you bought it for arrive unanswered — the stun is the matchup, not the damage.
edits.after: Aegis Assault blocks all frontal damage — an R held for the tidy finish gets eaten by the shield; fire it the moment his E is spent.
